from itertools import combinations
items=[
(346,'Lululemon Un Mat',58.0),
(1317,'Ashley HomeStore Shawnalore Coffee Table',470.0),
(1482,'Black Diamond Speed 40 Pack',134.9),
(2251,'REI Co-op Women\'s Stormhenge 850 Down Jacket',249.9),
(2278,'Staples Battery Operated Pencil Sharpener',7.5),
(2445,'Adams Manufacturing Quik-Fold Chair',11.0),
(2560,'Bell Z20 MIPS Bike Helmet',229.9),
(2688,'Topeak Mini Dual DXG Hand Pump',27.9),
(2691,'Escali Primo P115C Precision Kitchen Food Scale',24.9)
]

delivery_fee=5.0
tax_rate=0.1
best=[]
best_count=-1
best_total=None
best_base=None
for r in range(1,len(items)+1):
    for idxs in combinations(range(len(items)),r):
        base=sum(items[i][2] for i in idxs)
        total=delivery_fee+tax_rate*base+base
        if total<=500+1e-9:
            c=len(idxs)
            if c>best_count or (c==best_count and (best_total is None or total<best_total)):
                best_count=c
                best_total=total
                best_base=base
                best=[idxs]
            elif c==best_count and abs(total-best_total)<1e-9:
                best.append(idxs)
print('best_count',best_count,'best_total',best_total,'best_base',best_base,'num_solutions',len(best))
# show one solution
for idxs in best[:5]:
    print([items[i][0] for i in idxs],sum(items[i][2] for i in idxs))

# Clear the cart, then add as many wishlist items as possible within $500.
# Selected subset (6 items) expected to maximize item count under budget:
selected_product_ids = [346, 1482, 2278, 2445, 2688, 2691]
selected_qty = {pid: 1 for pid in selected_product_ids}

# 1) Clear cart
clear_res = apis.amazon.clear_cart(access_token=amazon_login['access_token'])
print('clear_cart:', clear_res)

# 2) Add selected wishlist items to cart
for pid in selected_product_ids:
    res = apis.amazon.add_product_to_cart(
        product_id=pid,
        access_token=amazon_login['access_token'],
        quantity=selected_qty[pid]
    )
    print('add_product_to_cart', pid, res)

# 3) Verify cart totals and items count (single pre-order verification)
cart_after = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_login['access_token'])
print('cart_after:', cart_after)
print('cart_item_count:', len(cart_after['cart_items']))

# 4) Get payment card + shipping address choices
payment_cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=amazon_login['access_token'])
addresses = apis.amazon.show_addresses(access_token=amazon_login['access_token'])
print('payment_cards_count:', len(payment_cards))
print('addresses_count:', len(addresses))

payment_card_id = payment_cards[0]['payment_card_id']
address_id = addresses[0]['address_id']
print('selected_payment_card_id:', payment_card_id)
print('selected_address_id:', address_id)

# 5) Place order
place_res = apis.amazon.place_order(
    payment_card_id=payment_card_id,
    address_id=address_id,
    access_token=amazon_login['access_token']
)
print('place_order:', place_res)
order_id = place_res.get('order_id')

# 6) Post-order verification (single read of the created order)
order_details = apis.amazon.show_order(order_id=order_id, access_token=amazon_login['access_token'])
print('order_details:', order_details)
print('order_item_count:', len(order_details['order_items']))
ordered_product_ids = [oi['product_id'] for oi in order_details['order_items']]
print('ordered_product_ids:', ordered_product_ids)
print('ordered_product_ids_set_match:', set(ordered_product_ids) == set(selected_product_ids))
print('paid_amount:', order_details.get('paid_amount'))

# Final success flags
success_flags = {
    'within_budget_500': order_details.get('paid_amount', 0) <= 500 + 1e-9,
    'max_item_count_expected_6': len(order_details['order_items']) == 6,
    'products_match_expected_6': set(ordered_product_ids) == set(selected_product_ids)
}
